newsitem.title: USA: Rochester G&E filing deadline extended.
newsitem.headline: Rochester G&E filing deadline extended.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission has extended restructuring talks with Rochester Gas and Electric Corp to March 10.

In a notice issued Thursday citing the reasonable possibility of a settlement, the commission said Chairman John O'Mara determined to extend the February 28 deadline for the utility's next filing in the commission's competitive opportunities proceeding.
The notice said Rochester G&E requested a two week extenstion to March 14 and reported substantial progress toward an agreement.
"The company anticipates the parties will continue to make progress and is optimistic a written statement of agreement can be presented in the time requested," the notice said.
